angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 730,485 km at 139.03 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.1929 +/- 0.0234 mas (same row, RUWE 1.22): 139.03 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.05 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Mann et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract): 730,485 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.56 +/- 0.09 solar masses from Mann et al. 2016, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3540 +/- 70 K from Mann et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mann et al. 2016, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-33 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-33.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.144, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-33 (pscomppars): spectral type M3.3, from Mann et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-33 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.82391, from Mann et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-33 (pscomppars): age 0.0093 Gyr, from Mann et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-33 (pscomppars): rotation period 6.29 d, from Mann et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-33 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 8.2 km/s, from Mann et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016AJ....152...61M/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.05 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.971. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
